node.title: E22 lower-scale intersection profile counts
node.statement: For every dyadic pair M_i<M_j and every subset of smaller dyadic scales M'<M_i, compute the exact weighted count of residual-profile data that are raw-admissible at M_j and simultaneously admissible at all scales in that subset, using the dyadic_profile_evaluation multiplicity convention. This is reduced to weighted-intersection certificate soundness plus the remaining formula payload.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the proved weighted-intersection certificate rule and the remaining exact formula payload
node.falsifier: an intersection of lower-scale admissibility events counted with the wrong size or multiplicity, or a defect in the certificate soundness rule
